title: In ovo technique for cell injection in the CPM followed by bead implantation in the BA2 of chicken embryos
author: Yahya, van Lin, et al.
materials: The AG beads (AG 1-X2 resin, 143-1255, Bio-Rad) were placed on the top of the microcentrifuge cap and soaked in a 1 μg/ml SDF-1 (300-28A; PeproTech). Control beads were soaked in PBS. The caps with beads were afterwards placed into small Petri dish surrounded by Cellulose compress (900-0853, Henry Schein). Few drops of Locke’s solution were adsorbed onto Cellulose compress, to create a humid environment which will avoid the dryness of the beads. The dishes were sealed with parafilm and kept at 4 °C overnight (Fig. 4 and Video 3).Fig. 4Beads preparation.Fig. 4Fig. 5In ovo quail cell injection, bead implantation in BA2 and whole mount immunostaining. Stages of development are indicated at the top of the panel. (A) Dorsal view of stage HH10 embryos injected with quail cells (arrowhead 1). (B) PBS or SDF-1 beads implantation into the BA2. Arrowheads 2 indicate the beads. (C) Second branchial arch region of chicken embryos injected with quail cells. SDF-1 bead attracts QCPN positive (quail) cells (C), whereas QCPN positive cells in the PBS beads treated embryos migrated normally and located in the central portion of the BA2 (yellow arrows in photo D).Fig. 5

steps.title: Store and incubate fertilized eggs
steps.instruction: Obtain fertilized chicken eggs, store at 8–16 °C, rinse with 70 % ethanol, then incubate at 37 °C and 80 % relative humidity until embryos reach stage HH10‑11.

steps.title: Create access window in egg
steps.instruction: At stage HH10‑11, make a hole in the side of the air chamber with small surgical scissors, withdraw 2–3 ml albumen using a sterile syringe, cover the upper side of the egg with medical tape, and cut an oval window ≈2 cm long on the same side.

steps.title: Prepare SDF‑1 and control beads
steps.instruction: Place AG 1‑X2 resin beads (Bio‑Rad, catalog 143‑1255) on a microcentrifuge cap; soak experimental beads in 1 µg/ml SDF‑1 (PeproTech, 300‑28A) and control beads in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Put caps with beads into a small Petri dish surrounded by Cellulose compress (Henry Schein, 900‑0853).
Add a few drops of Locke’s solution onto the compress to keep beads humid.

steps.title: Store beads overnight
steps.instruction: Keep the sealed bead dishes at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Fix embryos for whole‑mount staining
steps.instruction: Isolate embryos at stages HH19‑22 and fix them overnight in 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dehydrate and store embryos
steps.instruction: Dehydrate embryos through a graded methanol series in PBS at room temperature, then store them at –20 °C.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate embryos in 6 % H₂O₂ dissolved in methanol for 6 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Rehydrate and block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Rehydrate embryos and block them in PBST containing 2 % non‑fat milk and 1.0 % Triton X‑100 for 1–2 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary anti‑quail antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute mouse anti‑quail QCPN monoclonal antibody 1:50 in blocking solution and incubate embryos for 2 days at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash embryos five times, 1 h per wash, in blocking solution at 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate embryos in goat anti‑mouse HRP‑conjugated antibody (1:200, Jackson ImmunoResearch) diluted in blocking solution overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after secondary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash embryos five times, 1 h per wash, in blocking solution at 4 °C.

steps.title: Develop DAB color reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare staining solution containing 250 µl DAB (0.16 mg/ml), 1750 µl PBS and 2 µl 30 % H₂O₂; incubate embryos in this solution for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse and post‑fix embryos
steps.instruction: Remove staining solution, rinse embryos in PBS for 10 min at room temperature, then fix them overnight in 4 % PFA in PBS at 4 °C.

steps.title: Capture images of stained embryos
steps.instruction: Image the embryos using a Leica M165 FC stereo microscope equipped with a DFC420 C digital camera.
